GLS.feature.pf2e-variant-rules.title: PF2e Variant Rules
GLS.feature.pf2e-variant-rules.hint: Optional rules from Adventures+. Enable this, then switch on the individual rules your table uses.
GLS.feature.vr-careful-consumption.title: Careful Consumption
GLS.feature.vr-careful-consumption.hint: Spend an extra action to take the maximum from a consumable instead of rolling.
GLS.feature.vr-chip-damage.title: Chip Damage
GLS.feature.vr-chip-damage.hint: A missed Strike or a critically successful save still deals a little guaranteed damage.
GLS.feature.vr-dents.title: Dents
GLS.feature.vr-dents.hint: Item durability as a dent count rather than a broken threshold.
GLS.feature.vr-lasting-wounds.title: Lasting Wounds
GLS.feature.vr-lasting-wounds.hint: Wounded survives a night's rest, hampers Medicine checks, and cuts healing received.
GLVR.settings.careful.healingOnly.name: Healing consumables only
GLVR.settings.careful.healingOnly.hint: Offer Careful Consumption only on items that restore Hit Points. The rule permits any variable effect at the GM's discretion; this restricts it to the common case.
GLVR.settings.careful.postRoll.name: Maximize from the chat card
GLVR.settings.careful.postRoll.hint: Add a button to an already-rolled consumable card that re-posts it at its maximum. This is more permissive than the rule: a player only presses it after seeing a bad roll, which removes the decision the activity exists to create. On by default, because the chat card is the only surface a player reaches mid-turn.
GLVR.settings.chip.autoApply.name: Apply chip damage automatically
GLVR.settings.chip.autoApply.hint: Skip the button and apply chip damage as soon as a qualifying outcome is posted. Off by default: PF2e exposes no hook on damage application, so the button is the safer path.
GLVR.settings.chip.useFlattenedLevel.hin: In a Proficiency Without Level world, reduce chip damage by the same amount PF2e Flatten subtracts from rolls. Off by default, because chip damage is a flat figure rather than a check.
GLVR.settings.dent.autoApply.name: Apply dents automatically
GLVR.settings.dent.autoApply.hint: Add dents without asking when an item takes damage.
GLVR.settings.dent.repairButton.name: Offer dent removal on Repair checks
GLVR.settings.dent.repairButton.hint: Add a button to a Repair check result that removes 1 dent on a success and 2 on a critical success.
GLVR.settings.wound.blockRest.name: Wounded survives a night's rest
GLVR.settings.wound.blockRest.hint: Rest no longer clears the wounded condition. PF2e's own rest summary will still report it as removed; a follow-up note says otherwise.
GLVR.settings.wound.medicinePenalty.name: Medicine penalty
GLVR.settings.wound.medicinePenalty.hint: Medicine checks targeting a wounded creature take a circumstance penalty equal to its wounded value. Treat Wounds records no target, so the patient is read from your current target or selected token.
GLVR.settings.wound.healingPenalty.name: Healing penalty
GLVR.settings.wound.healingPenalty.hint: Hit Points restored to a wounded creature are reduced by twice its wounded value. Applies to healing from chat cards; dragging a token's HP bar bypasses every modifier in PF2e and is unaffected.
GLVR.chip.title: Chip
GLVR.careful.title: Careful Consumption
GLVR.careful.hint: Take the maximum from this item instead of rolling.
GLVR.careful.shiftHint: Shift-click for an item made by a Chirurgeon with greater field discovery: it rolls its Hit Points and adds them to the maximum.
GLVR.careful.flavorChirurgeon: {name}, consumed carefully: maximum plus {bonus} rolled, for {total}.
GLVR.dents.title: Dents
GLVR.dents.repairBody: This result removes {count} dent(s). Choose the item repaired.
GLVR.wounds.restBody: The night's rest did not clear these wounds. PF2e's rest summary above reports them as removed; they were restored afterwards.
GLVR.error.noToken: {name} has no token on this scene, so the damage was not applied.
GLS.feature.vr-boss-creatures.title: Boss Creatures
GLS.feature.vr-boss-creatures.hint: Promote an NPC to a Greater or Supreme boss: more Hit Points, more turns a round, Boss Abilities, and Downfalls the party can trigger to break its defences.
GLVR.settings.boss.xpBudget.name: Count boss XP in the encounter budget
GLVR.settings.boss.xpBudget.hint: A Greater boss is worth twice its base creature and a Supreme three times. Switch this off to have the budget badge count a boss as an ordinary creature of its base level.
GLVR.settings.boss.incapacitation.name: Boss level applies to incapacitation
GLVR.settings.boss.incapacitation.hint: A boss counts as 2 levels higher (Greater) or 4 (Supreme) where a rule asks its creature level. This is the only part of that bump that reaches a roll.
GLVR.settings.boss.extraTurns.name: Give bosses their extra turns
GLVR.settings.boss.extraTurns.hint: Adds the boss's second and third turns to the initiative order. In card initiative mode the deck handles this instead and no extra entries are created.
GLVR.boss.title: Boss
GLVR.boss.notABoss: This creature is not a boss.
GLVR.boss.tierHint.greater: A miniboss. 2 turns a round, 1.5x Hit Points, counts as 2 levels higher and twice the XP.
GLVR.boss.tierHint.supreme: A solo threat. 3 turns a round, double Hit Points, counts as 4 levels higher and three times the XP.
GLVR.boss.statHint.level: Used where a rule asks the creature's level, such as incapacitation. The stored level is deliberately left alone so Proficiency-without-Level keeps subtracting the base creature's level and no more.
GLVR.boss.statHint.dc: A very hard DC of the base creature's level.
GLVR.boss.flattened: Flattened by {value} to match this world's Proficiency-without-Level scale.
GLVR.boss.abilities.heading: Boss Abilities
GLVR.boss.abilities.full: A boss carries at most {max} Boss Abilities.
GLVR.boss.abilities.kindHint.augmentive: Empowers what the boss already does.
GLVR.boss.abilities.kindHint.devastation: Telegraphed, and costs the boss actions.
GLVR.boss.downfalls.heading: Downfalls
GLVR.boss.downfallItem.name: Downfall: {trigger}
GLVR.boss.downfallItem.text: Triggering this Downfall gives the boss a -1 status penalty to AC and saving throws until the beginning of its next initial turn, climbing to -3 as separate Downfalls land, and disrupts anything it has Telegraphed. A boss cannot Shrug It Off.
GLVR.boss.downfalls.unbalanced: {abilities} abilities against {downfalls} downfalls. A boss should carry one downfall per ability.
GLVR.boss.downfalls.notePlaceholder: e.g. struck by an auditory effect
GLVR.boss.downfalls.penalty: Defences {value} until its next initial turn
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.action: A PC succeeds at a specific action that needs a check or attack roll.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.area: The boss ends its turn in a particular area or area effect.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.condition: The boss gains, or would gain, a specific condition.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.environmental: A circumstance on the battlefield is met.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.protective: Something the boss cares about is targeted with a hostile effect.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.trait: The boss is affected by an effect with a listed trait.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.weakness: The boss takes damage from, or is affected by, one of its weaknesses.
GLVR.boss.triggerHint.critical: Every boss carries this one: a critical success against one of its defences, or a critical failure on its own save.
GLVR.boss.telegraph.heading: Telegraph
GLVR.boss.telegraph.targetPlaceholder: who or what it is aimed at
GLVR.boss.chat.downfall: {name} suffers a Downfall. Defences {penalty} until the beginning of its next initial turn.
GLVR.boss.chat.downfallDisrupt: Its telegraphed {ability} is disrupted and cannot be used.
GLVR.boss.notify.notNpc: Only an NPC can be made a boss.
GLVR.boss.notify.noHp: This creature has no maximum Hit Points to scale.
GLVR.boss.core.telegraph.name: Telegraph
GLVR.boss.core.telegraph.text:
Signal the Boss Ability the boss means to use next. Choose one of its telegraph abilities; until the boss uses it, everyone can see it coming, and the target is shown along with it. The boss must use the ability before a full round passes or telegraph it again. Triggering a Downfall disrupts an active telegraph and the ability cannot be used.

Trigger The boss's turn ends, or it rolls initiative and knows of at least one enemy.
GLVR.boss.core.shrug-it-off.name: Shrug It Off
GLVR.boss.core.shrug-it-off.text:
Deny one impeding effect: either drop a single persistent damage effect (taking that damage first) or cut one condition or negative effect short by a round. As a free action at the start of its turn the boss can instead shed an effect lasting up to a minute, at the cost of all its actions that turn and its next Telegraph.

This cannot remove a Downfall's defence penalty.
GLVR.boss.ability.area-strike.name: Area Strike
GLVR.boss.ability.area-strike.text: Turn one of the boss's Strikes into an area attack. Pick the Strike and one of a 15-foot burst within 60 feet, a 30-foot cone, or a 60-foot line when you telegraph it; those choices are then fixed. Everything in the area takes the Strike's damage plus one extra damage die, basic Reflex save against DC {dc}.
GLVR.boss.ability.big-spell.name: Big Spell
GLVR.boss.ability.big-spell.text: Charge a single spell that targets one creature or an area. If the boss's next action casts it, use DC {dc} instead of the spell's own DC, or keep the creature's spell DC and raise it by 1. A single-target spell becomes a 10-foot burst; an area spell can grow to twice its size.
GLVR.boss.ability.buffeting-area.name: Buffeting Area
GLVR.boss.ability.buffeting-area.text:
Fly or Swim, churning the surrounding air or water in an emanation the size of that Speed. Creatures caught in it, or starting their turn in it, must succeed at a Fortitude save against DC {dc} or be pushed 10 feet away; a creature next to solid terrain may Grab an Edge instead. Moving towards the boss is difficult terrain. It lasts until the boss stops moving that way or its Downfall triggers.

Prerequisites The base creature has a fly or swim Speed.
GLVR.boss.ability.furious-combo.name: Furious Combo
GLVR.boss.ability.furious-combo.text: Use an action or activity that makes several Strikes, spending the same number of actions on it, and Step up to 10 feet after each Strike.
GLVR.boss.ability.kinetic-trample.name: Kinetic Trample
GLVR.boss.ability.kinetic-trample.text: Pick a damage type suited to the creature; the choice is then fixed. The boss Tramples, leaving difficult and hazardous terrain in every square it crosses. The hazard deals {hazardDamage} damage to anything starting its turn there and for each square moved through it, and lasts 1d4 rounds. The ability gains the trait matching the damage type.
GLVR.boss.ability.quick-rush.name: Quick Rush
GLVR.boss.ability.quick-rush.text: Choose an enemy. The boss Strides up to three times towards them, ignoring difficult and greater difficult terrain. The movement does not provoke reactions.
GLVR.boss.ability.reactive-slam.name: Reactive Slam
GLVR.boss.ability.reactive-slam.text:
Swat the triggering creature away. It attempts a Fortitude save, treating its result as one step worse if the Strike was a critical hit.

Critical Success Unaffected.
Success Knocked 5 feet away, direction of the boss's choice.
Failure Knocked 10 feet away. Colliding with a wall or barrier costs it 1d6 bludgeoning damage and leaves it off-guard until the start of its next turn.
Critical Failure As failure, knocked up to 20 feet.

Trigger The boss hits a creature with a Reactive Strike.
Requirements The boss's Downfall has not triggered since its last turn.
GLVR.boss.ability.smash-landing.name: Smash Landing
GLVR.boss.ability.smash-landing.text: Drop from above, Long Jump or High Jump, and land hard. The boss may land in an occupied space, shoving the occupant to the nearest space it could hold; this is forced movement. Everything in a 10-foot emanation takes {d10} bludgeoning damage, basic Fortitude save against DC {dc}. On a failure the creature is pushed to the edge of the emanation; on a critical failure it is knocked prone as well. The emanation is 15 feet for a Huge boss and 20 feet for a Gargantuan one.
GLVR.boss.ability.trap-prey.name: Trap Prey
GLVR.boss.ability.trap-prey.text:
Web, bind or root the triggering creature. It attempts a Reflex save against DC {dc}. However it lands, the whole effect ends the moment the boss's Downfall triggers.

Critical Success Unaffected.
Success The triggering condition instead lasts until someone spends an Interact action to end it, and the boss no longer has to maintain the circumstances that caused it.
Failure As success, but Interact will not end it; the creature must Escape against DC {dc}, or an ally must succeed at Athletics against the same DC.
Critical Failure As failure, and every attempt to free the creature takes a -2 status penalty.

Trigger The boss makes a creature immobilized, grabbed or restrained.
GLVR.boss.ability.vicious-charge.name: Vicious Charge
GLVR.boss.ability.vicious-charge.text:
Use an action or activity that pairs a Strike with a move action. The boss moves in a straight line at half Speed and, instead of Striking, deals that Strike's damage to every enemy it passes, basic Reflex save against DC {dc}. A critical failure also knocks the creature prone.

Special A boss with no suitable activity gains Sudden Charge.
GLVR.boss.ability.billowing-cloud.name: Billowing Cloud
GLVR.boss.ability.billowing-cloud.text:
Choose one damage type from acid, cold, fire or poison and one condition from clumsy, enfeebled or stupefied; both choices are then fixed. A 30-foot emanation of gas grants concealment and lasts 1d4 rounds, until a strong wind disperses it, or until the boss's Downfall triggers. The boss ignores both the damage and the concealment.

Creatures starting their turn inside attempt a Fortitude save against DC {dc} against {d6} damage.

Critical Success Unaffected.
Success Half damage.
Failure Full damage, and the chosen condition at value {conditionValue} while in the area and for a round after.
Critical Failure Double damage, and the condition value is 1 higher.
GLVR.boss.ability.consume-underling.name: Consume Underling
GLVR.boss.ability.consume-underling.text:
Devour an underling within reach. It drops to 0 Hit Points and the boss regains {consumeHealing} Hit Points.

Requirements A creature with the underling trait is within the boss's reach.
GLVR.boss.ability.command-underling.name: Command Underling
GLVR.boss.ability.command-underling.text:
Order every underling within 60 feet. Neither command costs the underlings any of their own actions.

Surround They Stride; afterwards, anything adjacent to an underling takes one underling Strike's damage, basic Reflex against DC {dc}. Underlings must have a melee attack to be given this order.
Target They loose a volley into a 20-foot burst within 60 feet of the boss, same damage and save. Underlings must have a ranged attack to be given this order.

Either way, a creature takes a cumulative status penalty to that Reflex save equal to the number of relevant underlings beyond the first, to a maximum of -4.
GLVR.boss.ability.duplicate.name: Duplicate
GLVR.boss.ability.duplicate.text: Create a copy of the boss within 30 feet. The two share Hit Points, resources and every frequency. Caught in one area effect the boss is affected once but rolls its save twice and takes the worse. A creature adjacent to two or more of them is off-guard to them. On each boss turn you choose which body acts, but every copy must act at least once a round or it destabilises and disperses. All duplicates dissolve the moment the boss's Downfall triggers.
GLVR.boss.ability.flashy-escape.name: Flashy Escape
GLVR.boss.ability.flashy-escape.text: Leave, dramatically and unfollowably. The boss is removed from initiative and from the encounter, in a manner the GM judges hard to pursue.
GLVR.boss.ability.grasping-appendages.te:
Raise {appendages} appendages, each within 30 feet of the boss and at least 15 feet from one another. They share the boss's level, AC, saves, resistances, immunities and weaknesses. The boss immediately uses Appendage Slam and may use it again on later turns while they stand.

The boss is immobilized while they are up, with a +2 status bonus against forced movement; move the boss and they vanish. Retracting them is a single action. They also retract the moment the boss's Downfall triggers.

Appendage Slam (1 action, once per turn) Each appendage slams one creature within 15 feet of it for {d8} bludgeoning damage, basic Reflex against DC {dc}. A critical failure leaves the creature grabbed until it Escapes against DC {dc}. An appendage already holding a creature must target that creature, which then takes a -2 penalty to the save.
GLVR.boss.ability.hazardous-spew.name: Hazardous Spew
GLVR.boss.ability.hazardous-spew.text: Choose one of acid, cold, fire or poison and one of a 30-foot cone, a 60-foot line, or a 20-foot burst within 120 feet; both choices are then fixed. The area becomes difficult and hazardous terrain for 2 rounds, dealing {hazardDamage} damage to anything starting its turn there and for each square moved through it. The ability gains the trait matching the damage type.
GLVR.boss.ability.reinforcements.name: Reinforcements!
GLVR.boss.ability.reinforcements.text:
Haul the fallen back up. Up to {reinforcements} underlings within 60 feet that dropped to 0 Hit Points in the last minute are restored to full. The boss cannot do it again for 1d4 rounds.

Requirements The encounter contains dead underlings.
GLVR.boss.ability.retaliatory-stance.tex:
Settle into a riposte. The boss gains a +2 status bonus to AC and the Retaliate free action. It can drop the stance as a free action at the start of one of its turns, or as a single concentrate action. The stance ends at once if the boss's Downfall triggers.

Retaliate (free action) Trigger An attack from a creature in the boss's reach targets it, while the boss is in this stance. Effect The boss makes a melee Strike against that creature.
GLVR.boss.ability.targeted-assault.name: Targeted Assault
GLVR.boss.ability.targeted-assault.text: When you telegraph this, choose a creature the boss could reach after two Strides. The boss Strides up to twice towards it and Strikes. A hit deals {assaultDice} extra weapon damage dice.
GLVR.boss.ability.thrash.name: Thrash
GLVR.boss.ability.thrash.text:
Bring the ceiling down in up to three 5-foot bursts within 120 feet. Creatures there take {d10} bludgeoning damage, basic Reflex against DC {dc}; a critical failure also pins them under the rubble until it is broken or they Escape against DC {dc}. A creature caught in overlapping bursts saves once and takes each damage type once.

The rubble stays as permanent stone objects the size of each burst: AC 10, Hardness 10, 25 Hit Points, immune to critical hits and precision damage. Anyone in the area is moved to the nearest free space unless restrained.

Special Thrash can use other damage types and leave other debris, as the setting suggests.
GLVR.boss.ability.unleash.name: Unleash
GLVR.boss.ability.unleash.text:
Everything within reach makes a Fortitude save against DC {dc} or is pushed back 5 feet and knocked prone.

For 1 minute the boss gains a +10-foot status bonus to its Speeds, a +1 status bonus to Strikes and skill checks, and {tempHp} temporary Hit Points. It cannot Unleash again until restored to full Hit Points. Triggering its Downfall suppresses the status bonuses until the end of its next turn.

Requirements The boss is below half its maximum Hit Points.
GLVR.boss.ability.violent-throw.name: Violent Throw
GLVR.boss.ability.violent-throw.text:
Grapple a creature smaller than the boss within melee reach, succeeding automatically against an underling, then hurl it at another creature or obstacle within 30 feet. Thrown and target both take {d10} bludgeoning damage, basic Reflex against DC {dc}, ignoring {baseLevel} Hardness if the target is an object.

Special No telegraph is needed to throw an underling.
GLVR.boss.ability.chained.name: Chained
GLVR.boss.ability.chained.text:
The boss is bound to an anchor point of your choosing. It cannot move further than a single Stride from that point, falling prone at the boundary if it tries, and can only make ranged attacks within its first range increment. It gains Unleash and one other Boss Ability of your choice; using Unleash breaks the chains and frees it.

A critical failure on an attack roll against the boss, or an area effect that includes it, calls for a DC 5 flat check. On a failure the boss is freed as though it had Unleashed, and may Unleash as a free action even without meeting the requirements.
GLVR.boss.ability.duo.name: Duo
GLVR.boss.ability.duo.text:
The boss is two creatures fighting as one. Combine both base creatures' XP and halve it before applying the boss multiplier. Take the smaller of the two Hit Point totals as the boss's starting Hit Points and split it evenly between them.

Either body may act on a boss turn, but each must spend at least one action; if one cannot act, the boss loses an action that turn. Choose one Boss Ability and one Downfall per body. Each uses its own ability, but either Downfall triggering hits both. Both gain Dynamic Duo.

Dynamic Duo (1 to 3 actions) Requirements A Boss Ability is telegraphed and both bodies can act. Effect One body uses the telegraphed ability for the same number of actions as Dynamic Duo; the other takes a single action.
GLVR.boss.ability.covert.name: Covert
GLVR.boss.ability.covert.text: If the boss ends its turn and takes no damage before its next one begins, it may Hide as a free action at the start of that turn. It can use its Boss modifier of +{modifier} for Stealth if that is higher, or keep the base creature's Stealth and raise it by 1. Taking damage while hidden, undetected or unobserved triggers its Downfall.
GLVR.boss.ability.impenetrable.name: Impenetrable
GLVR.boss.ability.impenetrable.text: The boss's hide turns almost everything: +2 AC and resistance {resistance} to all damage. When its Downfall triggers, it loses that resistance and drops 4 AC until the end of its next turn.
GLVR.boss.ability.infused.name: Infused
GLVR.boss.ability.infused.text:
The boss is infused with acid, air, cold, earth, electricity, fire, metal, water or wood. It gains Elemental Strike and immunity to that trait, and a weakness {weakness} to the damage type paired with it in the book's table. Dealing that damage triggers a Downfall.

Elemental Strike (1 action, once per turn) A Strike that also deals {d8} damage of the chosen type. The action carries that element's trait.
GLVR.boss.ability.fearful-knowledge.name: Fearful Knowledge
GLVR.boss.ability.fearful-knowledge.text:
At the end of each of its turns the boss learns what a successful Recall Knowledge would tell it about one creature within 30 feet, using the base creature's modifiers.

It can also Demoralize with a Recall Knowledge skill where the creature type fits, working on what it has learned. Learning something new about a creature strips that creature's immunity to the boss's Demoralize. Successfully deceiving the boss triggers its Downfall.
GLVR.boss.ability.retributive-mind.name: Retributive Mind
GLVR.boss.ability.retributive-mind.text: Succeeding at a save against a mental magical effect leaves whoever targeted the boss stupefied 1 for 1 round, or stupefied 2 on a critical success. Failing a Will save triggers the boss's Downfall.
GLVR.boss.ability.phase-change.name: Phase Change
GLVR.boss.ability.phase-change.text:
Choose 2 further Boss Abilities and 1 further Downfall trigger when the boss is built. At half its maximum Hit Points it sheds every ability it had for those two, and swaps one of its Downfall triggers for the new one. Healing back above the threshold restores what it had.

Special Take this more than once to split the Hit Point track into that many more thresholds, each with its own abilities and Downfall trigger.
GLVR.boss.ability.spawn.name: Spawn
GLVR.boss.ability.spawn.text: The boss gestates inside a host creature of your choosing. When the host dies or drops to 0 Hit Points, the boss bursts out and enters initiative immediately after that action. It arrives slowed 2, reducing that by 1 each turn it takes; at slowed 0 it becomes quickened instead, and may spend the extra action to Stride, Strike, or on an action from one of its Boss Abilities.
GLVR.boss.ability.stature.name: Stature
GLVR.boss.ability.stature.text:
The boss is Gargantuan, occupying a cube at least 5 squares on a side, with reach equal to one of those sides, and all its Speeds drop by 15 feet.

Creatures can Climb or Tumble Through along it, treating spaces adjacent to it as difficult terrain; climbers move at full Speed and a creature with a climb Speed ignores the difficulty. Anyone ending such a movement in the air is climbing the boss, provided it has a hand free or could climb without one. A climber treats the boss as off-guard. A melee Strike that succeeds while adjacent to the top of the boss's space triggers its Downfall.

Shaking climbers off is a single manipulate action: each must attempt a Reflex save or Athletics check against DC {dc}, falling on a failure for the appropriate falling damage, and on a critical failure landing that same distance away from the boss.
GLVR.settings.dent.config.name: Dent configuration
GLVR.settings.dent.config.hint: Thresholds, which categories of item dent, and the extra dents a grade or a precious material is worth. Edited from the Dent configuration sheet.
GLVR.dentConfig.title: Dent configuration
GLVR.dentConfig.label: Configure dents
GLVR.dentConfig.hint: Set the dent thresholds, choose which categories of item can be dented, and give grades and precious materials extra dents.
GLVR.dentConfig.lead: The book's rule is 2 dents broken, 4 destroyed, doubled for a sturdy shield. Everything on this sheet is your table's, and the shipped values are the printed rule exactly.
GLVR.dentConfig.thresholdsNote: The broken rung is always kept below the destroyed one. Equal or above would delete the broken state, and an item would go from working to gone in one hit.
GLVR.dentConfig.categoriesNote: PF2e gives almost no item any Hit Points, so this list is what decides where a dent track appears. Consumables and treasure are off by default: a potion that takes a hit shatters, and coins do not dent.
GLVR.dentConfig.materialsNote: Extra dents are added to the destroyed rung; the broken rung takes half of the bonus, rounded down. They stack with the sturdy multiplier, so a sturdy adamantine shield is both.
GLVR.dents.hardnessFrom.override: A per-item value set on this item.
GLVR.dents.hardnessFrom.system: PF2e computed this, including any reinforcing runes.
GLVR.dents.hardnessFrom.material: This material's own Hardness at this grade, from PF2e's tables.
GLVR.dents.hardnessFrom.config: The default for this item type, from the dent configuration.
GLVR.dents.asObject: Counted as a {size} object, not as carried gear.
GLVR.dents.perItemHint: Leave a field blank to inherit. The placeholder shows what this item would use on its own.
GLVR.dentConfig.hardnessNote: PF2e writes a real Hardness on shields and on nothing else, so every other item arrives at 0 and takes the maximum two dents from any hit that lands. A precious material supplies its own value from PF2e's tables; these are the fallback for everything plainer. Zero keeps the book's silence.
GLVR.dentConfig.sizeAware: Objects use the size table (Tiny 1/2 through Gargantuan 16/32)
